headline: A 2018 law renames the VA health care system in Lexington, Kentucky, and names two of its campuses after specific people.
what_it_does: The law officially names the Department of Veterans Affairs health care system in Lexington, Kentucky, the "Lexington VA Health Care System." It also names the facility at 1101 Veterans Drive the "Troy Bowling Campus" and the facility at 2250 Leestown Road the "Franklin R. Sousley Campus." It does not change services, funding, or eligibility rules.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on March 9, 2018.
